name: Cave Mushrooms
summary: Barithras Moonshade sends you behind Cliffspring Falls for rare fungi. In Auberdine, the night elf prepares a specialized potion and asks you to investigate troubling warnings from the Grove of the Ancients.

sections.title: A Recipe Behind the Falls
sections.body: Barithras Moonshade needs scaber stalks and a death cap for a potent mixture. Both grow in a damp cavern hidden behind Cliffspring Falls in northeastern Darkshore. Gathering these fungi is more dangerous than picking ordinary woodland herbs.

sections.title: The Ancients' Warning
sections.body: The tree guardians at the Grove of the Ancients warned Barithras away from the cavern. They sense a foul presence nesting in the mountain caves. Moonshade sends a hardy traveler to learn whether the elders' fears of a creeping evil in northern Darkshore are well founded.

aliases: where to pick up cave mushrooms
faq.answer: You receive the assignment from Barithras Moonshade, who lives in Auberdine, the night elf settlement on Darkshore's central coast.
The mushrooms grow in a cavern hidden behind Cliffspring Falls, along the mountain face northeast of Auberdine.

faq.q: Why won't Barithras Moonshade retrieve the mushrooms himself?
faq.answer: The Grove of the Ancients warned Barithras to stay clear of the falls. The great ancients sense that an unnatural, rising evil has taken refuge in the cave.
Moonshade needs five scaber stalks and one dangerous death cap mushroom for his potion.

faq.q: What does this errand lead to next?
faq.answer: After you verify the presence in the cave and deliver the fungi, you travel south to the ancient protector Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.

faq.q: Why are the Ancients concerned about Cliffspring Falls?
faq.answer: The Grove of the Ancients warned Barithras that a rising evil may lurk in the cave behind the falls. He asks you to gather mushrooms and investigate the warning.

angles.text: As an herbalist, you may value the hunt for death caps and scaber stalks. These particular fungi grow in dark caverns rather than lush woodland soil.
As a night elf, you know the Grove of the Ancients is deeply attuned to Darkshore's natural balance. Any disturbance beneath the falls concerns the Kaldorei.
As an Alliance member, you know Auberdine is the Alliance's main stronghold on the Kalimdor coast. Evil spreading in the eastern mountains threatens the whole shore.
